第五十三章 BOSS二阶段（第1页）
他好歹也是小无相寺的方丈，香会的掌香人。
就是那些朝中贵人，商贾巨擘，入了小无相寺，都得客客气气喊他一声慧能大师。
可眼前这个不知道打哪儿冒出来的小子，居然一而再再而三的挑衅他。
董华天等人也并未阻拦，在他们而言，当务之急是收拾战利品，而不是节外生枝。
折腾了大半夜，此刻晨曦微露，就连密林中也微微透进了光亮来，钟离陌的脸瞬间红透，如同火烧一般，偷偷看了雪儿一眼，生怕雪儿因此而不悦。
晶莹剔透的水晶棺被鲜血染成了一种透明的，妖异的血红色，若是此刻有人细看，就会发现那并非是单纯的血红色，而是隐隐地泛着一中黯淡的灰黑色微弱光芒。
一时间雪儿不禁有些惶惑起来，竟不知何为对，何为错，也分不清是非曲直，只是坐在那里发呆。
轩辕恨自始至终都防备着轩辕昰，一直出面的都是替身，所以，轩辕昰下意识地以为，那个替身就是真正的轩辕恨。
楚枫的母亲一听，也认为很有道理。悬着的心放下了不少，打开一个盒子查看。
回到家，发现房门虚掩，李青云从门缝钻进去，看到梁母梁教授正在招待郑嫣然。
这倒是真的，白雪连忙点点头，人家下厨煎炒烹炸做了那么多好吃的，自己吃得香喷喷，回头要是还抱怨吃多了，这是不是就有点白眼儿狼的性质了？
除了最初时的羞涩，后来她就很自然了，喝糖水，欣赏画作，时而轻轻走动，时而静静安歇，时不时的，还要取笑调侃一下满头大汗的林昊。
林锦鸿愣了下，暗道这也行，要是有人报是校长的儿子，那还不是连烟都省了。反正时间还有，他也不急，遂拉了旁边那张椅子，在老头的身边坐下，又掏了支烟递给老头。老头也不客气，接过烟，夹在耳朵上。
扶柳做好了杏仁茶面子，用个红木托盘端了进来，给贺宁馨和宋良玉一人放了一碗。
又让贺宁馨放心说皇贵妃很照顾她，前儿已经偷偷命人给她送了银霜炭过来。只是她不想惹赵婕妤生气，给皇贵妃添麻烦，所以命人到了晚上再点起来，免得太过招摇。
宏宣帝这才释然，笑骂了一句：“没出息！”又叫了人给大皇子上了一杯茶。
第二天的时候妹子在接到我们的电话之后，很开心，没有二十分钟就跑来了俱乐部，甚至是能够感受到她着急的样子，生怕我们临时反悔。
好在许有的是银子，简飞扬也不在这事上节省，两家又是领了圣旨，可着劲儿的花。
门口的两人也微微一愣，他们没想到这时候电梯里还有人，而且人数还不少。左前方的那个保镖轻声问了句：“主人，要不先等等吧？”在说话时，视线却没离开林锦鸿等人。
“你们赶紧滚，这片山谷半月之内被我占据了，其他的都不要多说！”这恶龙神色嚣张跋扈，看上去不像一般人。
“逸寒，这么说，你已经是我们公司最大的理事了？”韩庚也傻傻的问道。
“好刀！”陆为禁不住暗呼一声，长刀法宝在修仙界并不多见，从前他在天风暗市武器店中见过几柄，长度也就九尺左右，呆板而无灵气，只能当摆设使用，与近日见这长刀根本无法比。

Chapter 53 BOSS Phase 2 (Page 1)
After all, he is also the abbot of Xiaowuxiang Temple and the incense palmist of Xiang Hui.
Even those nobles in the court and businessmen who entered Xiaowuxiang Temple had to politely call him Master Huineng.
But this kid in front of him appeared out of nowhere and provoked him again and again.
Dong Huatian and others did not stop them. For them, the top priority was to collect the spoils rather than create extraneous problems.
After working hard for most of the night, the morning light showed slightly, and even the dense forest had a slight light. Zhong Limo's face instantly turned red, as if on fire, and he glanced at Xue'er secretly, fearing that Xue'er would be displeased by this.
The crystal clear crystal coffin was dyed a transparent and strange blood red by the blood. If anyone looked carefully at this moment, they would find that it was not pure blood red, but faintly glowing with a faint gray-black light.
For a moment, Xue'er couldn't help but feel a little confused. She didn't know what was right and what was wrong. She couldn't tell right from wrong. She just sat there in a daze.
Xuanyuan Hen was on guard against Xuanyuan Shi from the beginning to the end, and the one who always came forward was a substitute. Therefore, Xuanyuan Hen subconsciously thought that the substitute was the real Xuanyuan Hen.
When Chu Feng's mother heard this, she also thought it made sense. Feeling relieved a lot, I opened a box and checked it out.
When he got home, he found that the door was ajar. Li Qingyun got in through the crack in the door and saw Professor Liang, Liang's mother, entertaining Zheng Yanran.
This is true, Bai Xue nodded quickly. People cooked so many delicious things in the kitchen, and he ate deliciously. If he complained about eating too much later, wouldn't he be a bit like a wolf?
In addition to being shy at the beginning, she became very natural later on, drinking sugar water, admiring paintings, sometimes walking gently, sometimes resting quietly, and from time to time, she would make fun of Lin Hao who was sweating profusely.
Lin Jinhong was stunned for a moment and thought to himself that this would be fine. If someone reported that he was the principal's son, he would not even have to smoke. Anyway, there was still time, so he was not in a hurry, so he pulled up the chair next to him, sat down next to the old man, took out another cigarette and handed it to the old man. The old man was not polite, took the cigarette and clamped it to his ear.
Fuliu made some almond tea and brought it in on a mahogany tray, placing a bowl for each of He Ningxin and Song Liangyu.
She also reassured He Ningxin that the imperial concubine took good care of her, and Qian'er had secretly ordered someone to send her silver frost charcoal. It's just that she didn't want to make Zhao Jieyu angry and cause trouble to the imperial concubine, so she ordered people to light it up at night to avoid being too ostentatious.
Emperor Hongxuan was relieved and cursed with a smile: "You're worthless!" He then asked someone to serve the eldest prince a cup of tea.
The next day, the girl was very happy after receiving our call. She came to the club within 20 minutes. You could even feel her anxious look, fearing that we would regret it temporarily.
Fortunately, Xu You had plenty of money, and Jian Feiyang didn't skimp on this matter. The two families had received the imperial edict again, so they couldn't spend more money.
The two people at the door were also slightly stunned. They didn't expect that there were people in the elevator at this time, and there were quite a lot of them. The bodyguard on the front left asked softly: "Master, why don't you wait first?" While speaking, his eyes did not leave Lin Jinhong and others.
"Get out of here quickly, I will occupy this valley within half a month, don't say anything else!" This evil dragon looked arrogant and domineering, and did not look like an ordinary person.
"Yihan, so you are already the largest director of our company?" Han Geng also asked stupidly.
"What a knife!" Lu Wei couldn't help but exclaimed inwardly. Long sword magic weapons are rare in the world of immortality. He had seen a few in the Tianfeng Dark Market weapons store before. They were only about nine feet long. They were dull and lacked aura and could only be used as decorations. They were incomparable to the long swords he saw recently.
